sarah: Heads up — noticed a regression on nightly: AWQ fp8 model running with batch_hint=auto started OOMing on 8xA100 rigs since yesterday's kernel selector change.
kevin: ugh. regression signal from canary or prod?
sarah: canary. small traffic but consistent. repro: single request with long prompt (seq=4096), kv_cache enabled. Previously fit, now OOM during decode (step ~260).
anya: any profiling traces? kernel choice logs?
sarah: yes. attaching paste of the runtime decision log and the memory snapshot (trimmed):
```
[2026-02-25T10:41:02Z] kernel_selector: chose kernel=flash_attn_v2 for layer=22 seq=4096 bsz=1
[2026-02-25T10:41:02Z] fallback: after 120ms exec, kernel=nv_flash fallback->matmul_impl (higher mem)
MEM: reserved=54.2GB used=50.7GB free=3.5GB
KV cache dtype=uint8 (AWQ packed), post-fwd upcast_pending=true
```
kevin: interesting — fallback to matmul_impl explains mem spike. why fallback? timeouts on flash kernel maybe hit fallback path which allocates different buffers.
mike: Also see our batching heuristics changed to be more aggressive: batch_hint=auto now merges micro-batches up to 4x for 'low-latency' class. Could be inflating workspace requirements.
anya: If the kernel fallback path uses transient float32 buffers for upcast, AWQ packed KV -> full upcast could blow memory. Did we change the upcast behavior recently?
sarah: yes, PR #4128 added deferred_upcast flag logic for mixed-precision fallback but it only toggles for gptq models. AWQ hit a different branch so got eager upcast.
kevin: quick mitigation: force KV cache dtype cast to fp16 before decode path? That reduces runtime upcast.
mike: we tried `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KV_CAST=fp16` in canary env — it reduced memory by ~9GB and avoided OOM for the repro. latency +2ms.
anya: good data. longer term: adjust allocator soft-reserve to account for fallback memory peak, or change kernel selector hysteresis so we avoid flapping between flash and matmul on marginal cases.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back kernel-selector change from canary 2026-02-24T23:50 -> 2026-02-25T11:05 by @kevin (reason: regression)
sarah: notes for follow-ups: (1) add explicit cast path for packed AWQ->fp16 when KV cache is used (2) add simple simulation of fallback peak to allocator sizing (3) instrument kernel latency variance to stop flapping (hysteresis window)
kevin: i'll open followup issues: #4271 (kv-cast), #4272 (allocator-soft-reserve-sim), #4273 (kernel-selector-hysteresis). I'll also add a short playback test that sends long seq prompts to catch this class.
anya: can we also add a perf test that exercises batch_hint=auto merging behavior so we catch workspace blowups?
mike: yes, add a flamegraph sampling around fallback path and add a test variant with AWQ/packed-kv models.
sarah: thanks. for now canary rolled back; moving to validate fixes on a separate canary lane before re-enable. :thumbsup:
